subject: Vendor portal maintenance sprint — Whistic & Vendr profile cleanup
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@fastpay.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Vendor portal maintenance sprint — Whistic & Vendr profile cleanup

Hi Liam,

We're planning a short maintenance sprint the week of Sep 20 to tidy up FastPay's security profiles in Whistic and Vendr so future evidence rotations are smaller and more predictable. High level goals: consolidate duplicate CAIQ answers, remove stale attachments, rotate any long-lived service accounts used for uploads, and surface SOC2/SIG gaps for a light remediation backlog.

What we'd like from your side:
- A single POC for uploads and service-account coordination (name + email).
- Confirmation whether you prefer us to upload artifacts into Vendr/Whistic directly or to presigned S3 locations you provide.
- Any known blackout windows for your security team between Sep 20–24.

Deliverables we plan to produce:
- a short runbook for profile upkeep (will attach a draft)
- a compact Whistic export with recommended deletions (we'll share CSV)
- a mapping of CAIQ -> internal docs for your auditors

Attaching our current inventory and the vendor-catalog mapping for context. Let me know if Wednesday (Sep 22) 10:00–11:00 PT works for a 30–45 minute kickoff with your team; otherwise propose two windows.

Thanks,

Sofia Ivanova
Senior Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: whistic-current-export.csv, vendor-catalog-map.xlsx

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@fastpay.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: compliance@fastpay.io
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 12:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal maintenance sprint — Whistic & Vendr profile cleanup

Sofia —

Thanks for the note. Wed Sep 22 10:00 PT works for me and I can loop in our security lead (compliance@fastpay.io). For uploads: we generally prefer presigned S3 for bulk artifacts (gives us better auditability); however, if you need us to accept direct uploads to Vendr or Whistic we can enable a temporary service account.

POC: Liam O'Connor (liam@fastpay.io) — I'll add Jenna Park (compliance@fastpay.io) to the kickoff invite. No planned blackout windows that week.

I'll also pre-share a copy of our latest SOC2 Type II (redacted) and the KMS rotation log if that helps with the CAIQ cleanup. If you want an initial sample of CAIQ answers we can export a trimmed JSON.

— Liam

On Thu, Sep 10, 2026 at 09:12 Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> We're planning a short maintenance sprint the week of Sep 20 to tidy up FastPay's security profiles in Whistic and Vendr...

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal maintenance sprint — Whistic & Vendr profile cleanup

Looping in a couple quick operational notes so we're ready for the kickoff:

- Redwood will prefer presigned S3 uploads for anything >50MB; small docs we'll push into Vendr's UI during the session.
- Marissa, can you own the Whistic checklist (QA + recommended deletions)? Mark milestone: produce a trimmed CSV by Sep 18.
- I'll draft a one-page runbook that lists: required evidence types (SOC2 report, CAIQ snapshot, encryption KMS rotation log, service-account audit), upload conventions, and rollback steps. Expect the runbook in draft by Mon Sep 13.

Sofia — please include a short mapping of which CAIQ sections we want to prioritize (we should treat network encryption + key management + third-party subservice orgs as top tier).

Karthik
Director, Security Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@fastpay.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2026 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal maintenance sprint — Whistic & Vendr profile cleanup

Thanks, all — Wed Sep 22 10:00 PT confirmed. I'll send a calendar invite (30m) with a short agenda: kickoff + upload method decision + runbook review.

Agenda (30 min):
- Introductions & POCs (5m)
- Upload approach (presigned S3 vs direct UI) and minimum artifact list (5m)
- CAIQ triage priorities and mapping deliverables (10m)
- Next steps, owners, deadlines (10m)

Quick checklist for the meeting: please have one example of each artifact type ready to share: SOC2 Type II redacted (PDF), CAIQ export (JSON), KMS rotation log (CSV), and any existing evidence index. We'll attach the runbook draft and the whistic CSV after the call.

Meeting link: https://meet.redwoodinference.com/meet/abc-portal-maint (invite to follow)

Attachments referenced: redwood-portal-maint-playbook.pdf (draft), whistic-current-export.csv, vendor-catalog-map.xlsx

Sofia
Senior Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
